name: βk-methamnetamine
summary: 2-Naphthylmethcathinone (BMAPN), also known as βk-methamnetamine, is a stimulant drug of the cathinone and naphthylaminopropane families. It inhibits dopamine reuptake and has rewarding and reinforcing properties in animal studies. It is banned under drug analogue legislation in a number of jurisdictions.

pharmacology.text: It inhibits dopamine reuptake and has rewarding and reinforcing properties in animal studies.

uses.en: It is a research chemical with no medical use, studied in animals for its stimulant and rewarding effects.
uses.zh: 它是研究化學品，沒有醫療用途，曾在動物身上研究其興奮與酬賞作用。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究化学品，没有医疗用途，曾在动物身上研究其兴奋与酬赏作用。

sideEffects.en: It has not been studied in people. In animals it was rewarding and reinforcing, which points to a risk of dependence. Synthetic cathinones can cause a racing heart, raised blood pressure, sleeplessness, anxiety and psychosis.
sideEffects.zh: 它未曾在人體研究過。在動物身上它具有酬賞與強化作用，顯示有成癮風險。合成卡西酮可能造成心跳急促、血壓升高、失眠、焦慮與精神病。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它未曾在人体研究过。在动物身上它具有酬赏与强化作用，显示有成瘾风险。合成卡西酮可能造成心跳急促、血压升高、失眠、焦虑与精神病。

fact.en: It carries a naphthalene ring, two fused benzene rings, where most stimulants of this family have just one. That is also what gives naphthalene its familiar mothball smell.
fact.zh: 它帶有萘環，也就是兩個稠合的苯環，而這個家族的多數興奮劑只有一個苯環。萘也正是樟腦丸那股熟悉氣味的來源。
fact.zhHans: 它带有萘环，也就是两个稠合的苯环，而这个家族的多数兴奋剂只有一个苯环。萘也正是樟脑丸那股熟悉气味的来源。
